items.summary: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. items.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. items.summary: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. items.summary: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. items.summary: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. items.summary: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and restructuring from AI-backed dictation tools. items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming database interaction paradigms, evolving from simple query translators to autonomous database administrators (DBAs). items.summary: Hallucination remains a critical challenge for developing trustworthy Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). items.summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) focuses on comprehensively interpreting abnormal events in videos, requiring models to identify anomalous occurrences, discover their supporting evidence, and explain the underlying causes beyond simple anomaly detection. items.summary: Explaining the predictions of neural networks is a central challenge in trustworthy AI. items.summary: Agent self-evolution updates an agent's persistent state from prior experience and reuses it to solve related tasks more effectively. items.summary: Zero-shot 3D visual grounding aims to localize specific objects based on textual descriptions and 3D visual input.
